subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 6 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these exact upstream action commits for credential-bearing container publishing and security-reporting workflows after a maintainer refreshes the branch against current main?
rationale: The code change is intentionally limited to immutable third-party action revisions, but accepting supply-chain changes in workflows that handle registry credentials and security reports requires repository-owner trust judgment beyond mechanical diff review.

options.title: Refresh and verify pins
options.body: Rebase or recreate the same six full-SHA updates on current main, review their upstream provenance, and require final workflow results before merge.

options.title: Hold current action pins
options.body: Close or defer this update if the team does not want to advance these third-party action revisions in credential-bearing workflows now.

recommendation.title: Refresh and verify pins
recommendation.body: Rebase or recreate the same six full-SHA updates on current main, review their upstream provenance, and require final workflow results before merge.
